== Summary ==
Slip “•Baron Soontir Fel” cut unchanged from page 1 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (PDF file created 2 February 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (69, 1087, 581, 1362)). Version [[Baron Soontir Fel (V)|Baron Soontir Fel (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
